assumptions: A borrowed move is its native row on the borrower's discipline: it reads the borrower's weapon skill and blow (17 section 3 proposal)
The penalty is a flat multiplier on every number the row lands; mana, cooldown, rune and area are unchanged
An ally heal keeps the native caster's 7-tile reach where the cell names it (the engine otherwise gives a melee borrower 1 tile)
A borrowed shot move carries its own arrows (the free rung: the borrowed cast reads its native weapon's blow, never the arrow)
A borrowed Greater Mend reaches 7 tiles, its native healer's range (17 section 3 "Reach")
A borrowed Protective Ward reaches 7 tiles too
A borrowed Challenge taunts from any seat at its full hold (17 section 3 "Taunts")
